unit.why: A letter (approbation-like) by R. Moshe of Zhidachov about printing his brother R. Zvi Hirsh's Ateret Zvi, with a teaching on 'וראיתם את הארץ' but no narrated event; it ends with the heading of the next section.
unit.boundary_note: the closing words 'מערכת ד. דודינו הרה"ק ר׳ אלכסנדר סענדר מקאמרנא' are the section heading of the next division
